hero.intro: A hands-on program where interdisciplinary teams of product managers, designers, software and AI engineers turn real company challenges into tested digital products.

what.label: What is Product Studio?
what.title: A hands-on product development experience.
body: Product Studio brings together interdisciplinary teams from product management, software engineering, AI engineering, interaction design and other roles.
Together, they work on concrete digital challenges from companies — from problem definition through user research and prototyping to tested digital products.
what.spinoff: Product Studio is a spin-off of Digital Product School, one of Europe’s best-known training programs for cross-functional product teams.

journey.label: Journey
journey.title: From problem to product in 12 weeks.

steps.text: Join a cross-functional team and meet your partner’s challenge.

about.label: About us
about.title: Learning by building.
about.intro: We believe the best way to learn product development is to do it: with a real problem, a real team and real users. Product Studio creates that environment.

story.title: Our story
body: Product Studio started as a spin-off of Digital Product School (DPS), the Munich-based program that has trained cross-functional product teams for years.

We bring the DPS way of working — interdisciplinary teams, real challenges, user-centred methods and modern technology — to Türkiye, and adapt it to our local ecosystem of students, professionals and companies.

items.title: Real over theoretical
items.text: Every team works on a real challenge from a real company.

items.title: Users first
items.text: We test ideas with people, not with opinions.

items.title: Together
items.text: Great products need product, design, engineering and AI in one team.

items.title: Ship it
items.text: We value working, tested products over perfect slides.

mentors.label: Mentors
mentors.title: Guided by practitioners.
mentors.intro: Our mentors work in the industry every day. Each track is supported by experienced people who coach the teams throughout the batch.

partner.label: Become a partner
partner.title: Bring us your challenge.

items.title: Fresh perspective
items.text: A cross-functional team looks at your problem without internal constraints.

items.title: Tested prototype

items.title: Talent access

items.title: Methods you keep

apply.label: Apply now
apply.title: Build real products with a real team.
apply.intro: Join Product Studio as a product manager, interaction designer, software engineer or AI engineer. Work full-time in a cross-functional team on a real challenge from a partner company.
apply.closedText: You can still send your details. We will contact you when the next batch opens.

who.title: Who can apply?
items: University students (preferably in their final years), recent graduates and early-career professionals.
You can commit full-time for the whole batch.
You enjoy working in a team with people from other disciplines.
You are comfortable working in English and Turkish.

steps.title: Apply online
steps.text: Fill in the form below. It takes about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Interview
steps.text: Shortlisted candidates are invited to an interview or case task.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.text: Successful candidates are matched into teams before kick-off.

items.q: Is the program free for participants?
items.a: Yes. Participation in Product Studio is free of charge.
You need solid basics in your role. We care more about motivation, curiosity and teamwork than years of experience.

items.q: Can I participate while studying or working?
items.a: The program is full-time and intensive. Please make sure you can dedicate your time for the whole batch.
Teams work in Turkish and English. Workshops and materials may be in English.

items.q: Can I apply for more than one role?
items.a: Please choose the one role that fits you best. You can mention other skills in your application.
